deviations: Map section 11 asked to lift 993/943/942/986/997/998/991 into lib/d17-figures shared modules — done; the three new pieces (1009/1010/1011) stayed as page-local consts because each is used on exactly one page.

a997/a998 were JSX on their home pages; converted to HTML-string exports (identical markup, style objects → style attributes) so both home and problem pages import one source. Solo cuts (sx--solo) are derived via string replace in the lib modules.

Map said a1009/a1010/a1011 need 'no new CSS' — true for the .sw-doc recipe, but the brief's ≤70svh/≤600px height constraint required small hook rules (stage min-height 520u, doc-l top 340u, reduced figure padding, wrapping register cells) added at the end of d17-problems.css.

Map section 8 said keep the three 900w money photos and 'set the band object-fit:cover at native width' — implemented as a new PhotoPiece maxWidth={900} prop (centred, object-fit:cover was already the component default) rather than per-page CSS.
Register updates (map section 10) and open items (section 12) are Claude's per the brief — not done here.

Global .a917/.a918 blocks in d17-global.css left in place: the home page uses its own d17-art.module.css copies; removing the globals is dead-code cleanup for a follow-up, not required by any step, and the brief prioritised not touching uncoordinated lines.
